title: Minimum Viable Listing Playbook for Partner Publish
body:
Purpose:
This is a tight, pragmatic playbook for producing a minimum-viable (MVP) cloud marketplace listing for partner integrations. Focus: get a compliant, testable tile live fast while preserving controls for escalation to a full listing.

When to use this doc:
- Early partner pilots and beta ISV listings
- Fast internal proofs of integration for revenue/SSO/KMS gating
- When legal or engineering resources are limited, but we need a publicly visible tile

High-level goals (MVP):
1) Tile copy that communicates value in <= 40 words.
2) One clear CTA: Start free trial / Request demo / Contact sales.
3) Accurate SKU/Entitlement mapping for trial provisioning.
4) Security & data-residency disclaimers present (minimal acceptable language).
5) A test plan that CI/CD or manual QA can run in < 2 hours.

Core deliverables for MVP listing:
- 30–40 word product blurb (final copy)
- 1 hero tile image (square 1200px for marketplace) + 1 small logo (400px)
- 3 short taglines/alternates for A/B tests
- SKU mapping table (trial SKU, paid SKU, meter if needed)
- Minimal legal text snippet (data residency + PII note)
- 3 smoke-test scenarios with pass/fail criteria
- Rollback & embargo instructions

Required acceptance checklist (must pass all items to push):
[ ] Title: <= 10 words, uses partner-friendly language, no trademark misuse
[ ] Blurb: 35 words or less; highlights 1 customer outcome and 1 differentiator
[ ] CTA: Single primary CTA with correct link (trial or contact)
[ ] Assets: Logo and hero image uploaded to CDN and referenced in tile JSON
[ ] SKU: Trial SKU mapped and test entitlement created in staging
[ ] Billing: Billing contact & price (or placeholder if billed off-marketplace)
[ ] Security: Data residency selection specified; KMS/HSM note if required
[ ] Legal: Minimal privacy snippet included; partner legal signoff (initial)
[ ] Telemetry: Tile view & click events wired to telemetry endpoint (dev env)
[ ] Smoke tests: 3 scenarios green in staging environment

Technical gating quick-check (engineering):
- OAuth/SSO: Basic redirect flow validated with 1 test org
- Network: Marketplace IPs whitelisted (if partner requires)
- Provisioning: Trial entitlement created via API or sandbox and consumption verified
- Secrets: API keys stored in KMS; no plaintext keys in tile config
- Telemetry: view/click/launch events emitted (sample JSON payloads attached)

Sample tile copy (MVP):
- Final blurb (35 words): "Redwood Sync for Ops: Embed production-grade LLM inference into your apps with predictable latency and cost. One-click provisioning, enterprise controls, and usage-based billing to scale from pilot to production."
- Short headline (<= 8 words): "Redwood Sync — Predictable LLM Serving"
- 3 alternate short taglines:
  * "Fast, reliable inference at scale"
  * "Deploy models in minutes, serve at production speed"
  * "Control cost, preserve quality"

Legal & security minimal snippet (MVP):
"Data may be processed in the Redwood-managed region you select. For regulated data, please contact sales for Private deployment options and a KMS-enabled contract."
(Requires partner-legal initial approval before publish.)

SKU & entitlement sample (for internal ops):
- trial_sku_internal: RBW-TRIAL-30D (auto-provision to partner org id)
- paid_sku_monthly: RBW-PRO-1 (metered per token)
- entitlement_flow: marketplace -> order webhook -> provisioning API -> status callback

Smoke test scenarios (execute in staging):
1) Tile visibility: Tile loads in marketplace staging and assets render (pass: hero & logo visible; fail: 404 on asset)
2) Trial provisioning: Click CTA -> order placed -> webhook triggers provisioning -> test entitlement present in partner org (pass: entitlement active; fail: webhook 500 or no entitlement)
3) Sample inference: Use provisioned credentials to call hosted API with small prompt; latency < 2s and response schema validated (pass: 200 + valid JSON; fail: auth error or malformed output)

Rollback & embargo plan:
- If post-launch critical bug found (billing, security, PII leak): immediately set tile to "hidden" in marketplace console and notify PM + Eng on-call.
- Rolling back copy only: update tile copy asset and re-publish; low risk path.
- If partner requests pause: set trial entitlements to disabled and update CTA to "Contact Sales" until resolved.

Operational notes for GTM:
- Owner: assign a single GTM lead for the listing (name and back-up) before publish
- On-call: engineering on-call must be aware of the publish window and reachable for 2 hours post-publish
- Metrics to monitor first 72 hours: tile views, CTA clicks, trial conversions, provisioning failures, error rate on inference API from partner org

Quick timeline for an MVP push (typical two-week sprint):
Day 0–2: Copy + assets + legal quick nod
Day 3–5: Engineering gating (SSO, provisioning, telemetry)
Day 6–8: Staging smoke tests + partner validation
Day 9–11: Fixes/QA
Day 12: Publish window (avoid Fridays) + 72 hour monitoring

Examples of escalation messages (Slack short-form):
- "[MVP Publish] Tile live in staging; provisioning OK. Can Eng on-call verify telemetry emits? CC @eng-oncall"
- "[Incident] Tile hidden due to entitlement failure. Rolling back to contact-sales CTA; ENG investigating. PM: @MartaRuiz"

Mini copy cookbook (editable snippets for PR):
- Long product line (50–70 words): "Redwood Sync for Ops connects your product to high-throughput LLM inference with deterministic latency and cost controls. Use our SDKs or marketplace provisioning to spin up production-ready endpoints, enforce quotas and routing policies, and run safe rollouts across environments."
- Short benefit bullets (use 3 in tile detail): "Predictable latency", "Cost controls & batching", "Private deployment options"

Open questions to resolve before full listing:
- Does partner require data residency certification (EU-H or APAC)? If yes, escalate to Private pre-req
- Is billing on-marketplace or off-marketplace? If off-marketplace, confirm redirect flow and legal text
- Are there PII-specific constraints requiring extra legal review?

Appendix: quick checklist to hand to partner (one-pager):
- Confirm title + blurb + CTA
- Provide high-res logo + hero image
- Confirm trial SKU and acceptance criteria
- Sign initial privacy snippet
- Provide staging test org credentials for OAuth test

Notes and revision history:
- 2025-11-12 Aisha Kapoor: initial draft for internal pilot listing playbook
- 2025-11-25 Grant Liu: added technical gating and smoke tests
- 2025-12-03 Marta Ruiz: legal snippet updated and added rollback guidance
